description: This file defines a custom exception class 'GroupLevelNotFoundException' used in the 'org.apache.fineract.portfolio.group.exception' package. It extends the 'AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException' to signal when a specified group level resource is not found, typically by ID.

classes.name: GroupLevelNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception indicating that a group level resource with a specified ID does not exist.

methods.name: GroupLevelNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that creates the exception with an error message and the invalid ID.
